negative_snippets: not recommended at all , place is very far from Delhi and there is no eating point or shop , it's very deserted and not safe at all for kids and women . one should avoid this hotel at all costs . there is no proper ventilation in room , and you have to climb many stairs to reach the rooms , my old parents had very difficult time. there was no lift . most of the rooms has bad odour and smell. bathrooms stink and stench .please avoid to escape bad experience.
